decisions.subject: Hierarchical Fallback Strategy
decisions.reason: V21 logic ensures robust neutralization even with small universe sizes by falling back to coarser groupings (Sector -> Exchange -> Global).
decisions.impact: Code logic now uses 5-tier fallback: L4(Sec x Prc x Liq), L3(Sec x Prc), L2(Sec), L1(Exch), L0(Global).

decisions.subject: Fama-French 3-Factor Integration
decisions.reason: Align with Institutional standards to remove exposure to Market, Size, and Value premiums.
decisions.impact: Added FactorNeutralizer class supporting rolling/expanding OLS on VNI, SMB, HML factors.

decisions.subject: Vectorization Enforcement
decisions.impact: Replaced loops with pandas transform/groupby operations. 10000 stocks processed in <1s.

decisions.subject: Unified Normalization Engine
decisions.reason: Standardize signal scaling across all alpha models.
decisions.impact: Implemented z-score, rank, and robust normalization with PIT-safe temporal windows.
